title: Customer overview
description: A compact overview of this CRM customer.

projects.title: Project name
projects.processStepsHint: Free-text steps are labels only. “Add round” adds exactly one feedback round after a step – every round counts on its own.
projects.currentProcessStepHint: Only free-text steps can be selected. Feedback rounds before the current step count as done.

feedbackRound.label: Feedback round {number}
feedbackRound.removed: Feedback round removed. The following rounds are renumbered.
feedbackRound.movedToStart: Feedback round {number} is now at the start.
feedbackRound.limitReached: A project can have at most {max} feedback rounds.

projects.formDescription: Set the status and process steps. Both can be adjusted later.
projects.empty: No projects have been created for this customer yet.

feedback.title: Feedback rounds
feedback.body: Soon the customer’s feedback rounds land here with text, files and status – and how many rounds are left.

onboarding.title: Onboarding form
onboarding.body: Soon you can read the onboarding form the customer fills in on the portal here and reuse their answers in one click.

hours.title: Hours & history
hours.body: Soon you will see the hour allowance here, every booking with a short note and how many hours are left. The customer sees the same on the portal.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.body: Soon you can store the logins for the accounts you manage for this customer here – encrypted and visible only to approved members.

chat.title: Customer chat
chat.body: Soon you can write to the customer directly here. They reply from the portal.
chat.readAlong: The customer reads everything here in their portal. Internal notes do not belong in this chat.
